caption: The drawing depicts a three-tiered wooden chest of drawers with a stepped, rectangular design, set against a plain, cream-colored background. The chest is colored in shades of brown to represent wood, and each tier decreases in width as it goes up, creating a stepped appearance. The topmost tier has two small drawers, each featuring two yellow-colored circular drawer pulls, flanked by vertical yellow and brown columns on each side. The middle tier is wider, containing one drawer with a single brown knob, and it is also flanked by two yellow and brown columns. The bottom tier is the widest, featuring two drawers with brown knobs, again bordered by two yellow and brown columns on either side. The chest stands on four small, round wooden feet, and the top is adorned with a round, blue-green object sitting on a short brown pedestal. The drawers and columns are symmetrically aligned, and the outline of the chest is sharply defined within a large rectangular border drawn on the paper.
title: Sewing Box
